name: price_logsd_retro_game
meaning: sd of log value, retro games
method: lognormal MLE (AIC best of 4)

name: price_logsd_figure
method: lognormal MLE
transfer_to_layer7: LEGO used as proxy for figures

name: price_logsd_limited_goods
meaning: sd of log value, limited goods
method: median over files of sd(log price)

name: seller_listings_nb_size
meaning: NB size (dispersion) of listings per seller
method: zero-truncated NB MLE on listings per seller
uncertainty: sold-only listings; stores are not C2C sellers
transfer_to_layer7: shape only, mean set by scale

name: rebid_fast_share
meaning: share of same-bidder re-bids within 10 min
method: empirical share
uncertainty: split point 10 min chosen by hand

name: rebid_fast_median_min
method: median of gaps <= 10 min

name: rebid_fast_logsd
method: sd of log gap <= 10 min

name: rebid_slow_median_min
method: median of gaps > 10 min

name: rebid_slow_logsd
method: sd of log gap > 10 min

name: snipe_offset_max_sec
meaning: snipes land uniformly in the last N seconds
method: last stage lasts ~2 min or less, alpha3 ~ 1 (uniform)

name: snipe_transmit_fail_prob
method: esnipe statistic, Sept 2000

name: snipe_unavailable_prob
meaning: planned late bidder not available at the end
method: median self-reported frequency

name: wtp_idio_logsd
method: idiosyncratic SD / mean valuation: MU 2978/18594=0.16, UD 4313/15459=0.28

name: buyer_daily_retention
meaning: probability an active buyer stays another day

name: supply_peak_ratio
meaning: top-4-hour share of auction ends / of bids (crowded scenario)
method: 37.6% of auctions vs 25.0% of bids end/placed 5-9 pm (Pacific)
uncertainty: US eBay hours, applied as a ratio only

name: thickness_elasticity
meaning: elasticity of visit rate in number of relevant auctions ending soon
source: baseline value; scenario D uses 0.47 from Bimpikis et al. 2020 Fig. 13
method: ASSUMED for baseline

name: fx_krw_per_usd_anchor
meaning: only used to sanity-check KRW medians

name: price_median_krw_tcg

name: price_median_krw_figure

name: price_median_krw_retro_game
method: US eBay median $58 x 1350 = 78,132; set lower for Korean market

name: price_logsd_tcg
method: no TCG data; inside observed 0.72-1.37 range of other collectibles

name: item_appeal_logsd
method: simulated-moment grid search, seed 101 (weighted squared relative error over bidders_per_auction_mean_pos, bids_per_bidder_in_auction_mean, share_repeat_bidder_pairs, share_bids_last_5min, share_auctions_last_bid_5min, share_bids_first_10pct, share_bids_last_60min, bids_per_auction_nb_size_mom, slope_log_price_log_bids_sold)

name: appeal_wtp_elasticity

name: series_zipf_exponent

name: seller_primary_category_share

name: visit_rate_median_per_day
meaning: median organic visit rate before scaling

name: visit_rate_scale
method: simulated-moment grid search, seed 101 (weighted squared relative error over bidders_per_auction_mean_pos, bids_per_bidder_in_auction_mean, share_repeat_bidder_pairs, share_bids_last_5min, share_auctions_last_bid_5min, share_bids_first_10pct, share_bids_last_60min, bids_per_auction_nb_size_mom, slope_log_price_log_bids_sold)

name: visit_rate_logsd
method: checked against bids-per-bidder Gini: J&S 0.48, Swoopo 0.75

name: buyer_hour_offset_sd
meaning: individual shift of the activity profile

name: budget_items_median
meaning: 30-day budget in units of main-category median value

name: buyer_initial_active_share
meaning: buyers active from day 0; rest join uniformly

name: style_share_early
method: simulated-moment grid search, seed 101 (weighted squared relative error over bidders_per_auction_mean_pos, bids_per_bidder_in_auction_mean, share_repeat_bidder_pairs, share_bids_last_5min, share_auctions_last_bid_5min, share_bids_first_10pct, share_bids_last_60min, bids_per_auction_nb_size_mom, slope_log_price_log_bids_sold)

name: style_share_incremental
method: simulated-moment grid search, seed 101 (weighted squared relative error over bidders_per_auction_mean_pos, bids_per_bidder_in_auction_mean, share_repeat_bidder_pairs, share_bids_last_5min, share_auctions_last_bid_5min, share_bids_first_10pct, share_bids_last_60min, bids_per_auction_nb_size_mom, slope_log_price_log_bids_sold)

name: watch_return_prob
